retrievalProfile.description: A soft pink layout featuring a central line-art bird illustration paired with bold, lowercase sans-serif typography and a list of secondary text on the left.
triggerTerms: textured pink background with floral watermark
excludeWhen: serif or script fonts are the primary focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by a dusty rose or bubblegum pink background with a subtle paper texture. A central, hand-drawn black line illustration of a bird in flight is the focal point. Large, lowercase sans-serif text is positioned in the bottom left, while a vertical list of names sits in the upper left. Faint, darker pink floral patterns act as a background watermark.
coreVisualRelationships: The bird illustration overlaps the background floral patterns but remains distinct through line weight.
The primary title text is significantly larger and bolder than the secondary list text.
The vertical list of names aligns to the left edge, creating a structured sidebar against the organic bird form.
The color palette is monochromatic pink with dark grey/black accents for clarity.
coreInvariants: Hand-drawn line art style for the central subject
Lowercase bold sans-serif for the main title
Subtle paper-like texture across the entire canvas

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A medium-scale bird illustration occupies the center-right, angled upwards.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold lowercase title in the bottom left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold title, moves up the left-side list, then follows the bird's flight path toward the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample breathing room around the bird and between the text blocks to maintain a 'soft' feel.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark charcoal or deep brown for primary text and line art
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep magenta for secondary title emphasis and background floral motifs
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value background with high contrast dark elements for legibility.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to shades of pink, white, and dark grey

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: All characters in the main title must be lowercase
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and sizes for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, geometric lowercase display style.
Provides a slightly more organic but still bold sans-serif feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square pink background with a subtle paper texture and faint, darker pink floral watermarks. Place a black line-art illustration of a bird in flight in the center-right area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold lowercase sans-serif title in the bottom left in dark charcoal. Above it, add a vertical list of names in a smaller, medium-weight sans-serif in deep magenta, aligned to the left margin.

verificationChecks: Is the bird illustration rendered in a hand-drawn line art style?
Is the background a textured pink with floral watermarks?

mustRedesign: Any specific logos or brand marks

avoid: Overly digital/clean vector lines (keep a hand-drawn feel)

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the bird line art doesn't look like a stock icon.
Verify the lowercase title is the most prominent element.
Confirm the paper texture is visible but not distracting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Pink textured background + floral watermark + line-art subject + bold lowercase sans-serif title + left-aligned metadata list.
